title: 熱流体工学
subtitle: Thermal and Fluid Science
teachers:
HIROMITSU Nagayoshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn static and dynamic fluid properties.
(2) Learn Bernoulli's principle.
(3) Learn the relation between heat and material properties.
(4) Learn heat conduction and heat convection.
advice:
This is the introduction to thermal and fluid science.
We will cover the following topics:
1. Physical properties of fluids.
2. Static characteristics and dynamic characteristics of fluids.
3. Basic governing equations of fluids.
4. Bernoulli's principle.
5. Relation between heat and phase change of materials.
6. Heat conduction and heat convection.
Students will also learn about advanced issues such as radiation.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to complete advanced exercises independently.
Students are required to review each unit with on-demand learning materials.
Student should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of lectures, quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the concept of fluid properties, especially effects of compressibility and viscosity.
(2) Understand the physical meaning of continuity equations.
(3) Understand the physical meaning of momentum equations.
(4) Understand the physical meaning of energy equations.
(5) Analyze fluid and thermal phenomena using continuity, momentum, and energy equations.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain the fluid properties, pressure and buoyancy.
(2) Understand pressure distribution in a stationary fluid.
(3) Understand flow patterns.
(4) Calculate a pressure distribution using Bernoulli's principle.
(5) Understand the relation between heating and phase change.
(6) Calculate the heat conduction.
(7) Calculate the heat convection.
